integrity: The all-parameter statements are established by explicit matrix algebra and global sign analysis; finite symbolic and numeric checks in verify.py are secondary evidence. Publication priority remains subject to independent assessment.
limitations: Exactly two nonnegative ordinary backward-Euler stages on one planar damped Jordan shear; fixed physical horizon and terminal induced Euclidean norm only. Zero step permitted; the strictly-positive restriction need not attain the infimum. No physical-time error or cost-optimality statement.
title: A golden-ratio horizon for optimal two-stage backward-Euler damping of a Jordan shear
